caption:
Something new for this group 👇

You've been getting photography tutorials here for a while. That continues — but from today I'm also going to show you Alux Art, the studio I've been building.

It relights and reshoots photos you already took. No gear, no studio booking, no waiting on edits.

And the tutorials change too: no more walls of text. Everything comes as a carousel from now on, here and in the Telegram group.

First lesson drops this week.

slides.title: What is Alux Art?
slides.body: A studio that runs on the photos you already have. Upload a shot, pick a look, and it comes back relit — or reshot in a whole new setup, with the same face.

slides.title: What you can do with it.
items: Relight a photo you shot years ago
Reshoot a client in an outfit they never wore
Sell your own lighting style as a template
Deliver a full set without booking a studio

slides.title: No more walls of text.
slides.body: Every tutorial from now on comes as a carousel like this one — here on WhatsApp and in the Telegram group. Easier to read on a phone, easier to save, easier to come back to.

slides.title: First lesson this week.
slides.body: Stay in the group. If you want to look around before then, the studio is live.
